description: Defines the ScriptDict class and related iterators for Python bindings of c10::Dict in TorchScript, including methods for dictionary operations and iteration.

classes.name: ScriptDict
classes.description: A wrapper around c10::Dict exposed to Python with dictionary-like API, supporting key-value operations and iteration.

classes.name: ScriptDictKeyIterator
classes.description: Iterator over the keys of ScriptDict, supporting .keys() and iteration.

classes.name: ScriptDictIterator
classes.description: Iterator over key-value pairs of ScriptDict, supporting .items().

methods.name: initScriptDictBindings
methods.description: Initializes Python bindings for ScriptDict in the given module.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the dictionary.

methods.name: repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the dictionary.

methods.name: iter
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the dictionary's keys.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the dictionary's key-value pairs.

methods.name: toBool
methods.description: Interprets the dictionary as a boolean; empty is false, non-empty is true.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Gets the value for a given key, throws if key does not exist.

methods.name: setItem
methods.description: Sets the value for a given key.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the dictionary contains a given key.

methods.name: delItem
methods.description: Deletes a key from the dictionary.

methods.name: len
methods.description: Returns the size of the dictionary.
